answer: Sybil resistance comes from EigenTrust’s reciprocity-weighted trust graph and exponentially decaying reputation: the half-life forces identities to sustain honest service rather than rely on stale credit. Fresh nodes, whether labeled timber, fable, or opal, have no established trusted paths and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality; multiplying identities cannot bootstrap influence, so they cannot pass consensus thresholds without repeated validation from trusted peers.
